drawings.description: à droite, une figure : un cercle portant les points $\zeta_{-1}$, $\zeta_0$, $\zeta_1$, $\zeta_2$, $\zeta_3$, et plus haut à gauche $\zeta_{n-2}$ ; des flèches vont de $\zeta_{-1}$ à $\zeta_0$ (épaisse), de $\zeta_0$ à $\zeta_1$ ($e_1$), de $\zeta_1$ à $\zeta_2$ ($e_2$), de $\zeta_2$ à $\zeta_3$ ($e_3$), côtés successifs d'un polygone régulier inscrit, et une flèche épaisse marquée $\alpha$ va de $\zeta_0$ à $\zeta_3$.
drawings.kind: regular polygon inscribed in a circle, with side vectors and a diagonal
drawings.notes: A freehand circle of which he draws the arc from the right, over the top (where it carries a small brace-like kink), round the left down to zeta_0; the lower right part, where the polygon lies, is not closed, and it is left open here. The five consecutive vertices zeta_{-1}, zeta_0, zeta_1, zeta_2, zeta_3 are placed where they stand on the page (zeta_0 and zeta_1 inside the circle, the steps unequal); arrows along the four sides, the first heavy, the others labelled e_1, e_2, e_3; a heavy arrow alpha from zeta_0 to zeta_3, with a second, thinner arrow from zeta_0 half-way along it; the label zeta_{n-2} beside the upper left of the circle, with no point. The text says u is the rotation sending zeta_i to zeta_{i+1}, so the vertices are meant equally spaced; the page draws them freehand, and the redraw follows the page. Nothing struck; the foot of the half-sheet is torn below the figure. Overlaid 2026-11-12 (Opus 5.5) on a 400 dpi colour render: the earlier redraw put the vertices at equal steps on a fitted circle, up to 5 units from the page, with a circle too large and labels displaced; redrawn on the vertices, arc and labels measured on the page. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.
